image_description: A close-up underwater shot of a chiton (polyplacophore) clinging to a rough, sandy rock surface. The organism displays its characteristic eight overlapping dorsal plates embedded in a textured girdle. To the left, there is blurry marine vegetation or anemone tentacles. The lighting is natural, highlighting the wet texture of the shell and the surrounding substrate.
